fields.description: Map each ERPNext company to its corresponding Branch & Division account. When an Inter-Company Transfer is submitted, the system uses this table to determine which account to debit or credit in each company.
fields.label: Company → Branch Account Mapping

fields.description: Number of days after which a Pending Review ICT entry is flagged as overdue. Used for portal badge color and future email alerts.
fields.label: Pending Review Alert After (Days)

fields.description: If enabled, the Remarks field becomes mandatory before submission.
fields.label: Require Remarks on Every Transfer

fields.description: The account_name of the Branch & Division group in your Chart of Accounts — without the company suffix. E.g. 'Branch / Divisions' or 'Branch & Division'. The system will search for this group as: [name you enter] - [company abbr]
fields.label: Branch & Division Group Name
